quote: Su dieci voli programmati, sette arrivano a destinazione.

speaker: Carabinieri investigation (Poggioreale)
claim: Poggioreale investigations describe night flights, frequently changed launch sites such as terraces, boosted drones and cargo hung on transparent lines to reduce visibility.
quote: Si parla di voli eseguiti di notte, partenze da terrazzi o da zone vicine cambiate spesso, di droni potenziati capaci di volare più in alto del normale e utilizzo di carichi appesi con fili trasparenti o contenitori scuri.

speaker: Vincenzo Musacchio
claim: A mid-range drone costs a few hundred euros; losing one is negligible for the criminal organisation compared with the cargo value.
quote: Un drone di fascia media costa poche centinaia di euro; se è intercettato o cade, la perdita economica per l’organizzazione criminale è irrisoria rispetto al valore del carico consegnato

speaker: Emilio Fattorello
role: national councillor, OSAPP prison police union
claim: Organised crime keeps systematically using technology and over-the-wall throws to supply inmates with drugs and banned objects.
quote: la criminalità organizzata continui a sfruttare sistematicamente la tecnologia e i lanci dall'esterno per rifornire i detenuti di droga e oggetti vietati

speaker: Massimo Catalano
role: local secretary, Al.Si.P.Pe. prison police union
claim: Union says criminal use of drones against prisons is increasingly widespread and requires advanced technological tools.
quote: Occorre dotarsi di strumenti tecnologici all’avanguardia per far fronte a questo sempre più dilagante utilizzo dei droni da parte della criminalità

notes: union statement, not an agency
speaker: Sappe
role: prison police union, secretary general Donato Capece
claim: The Poggioreale case confirms the established phenomenon of illicit drone trafficking into prisons, aided by detainees' freedom of movement under the open custody regime.
quote: conferma tutte le ipotesi investigative circa l'ormai conclamato fenomeno di traffico illecito a mezzo droni

notes: union statement, not an agency
speaker: Uspp
role: prison police union, president Giuseppe Moretti
claim: A technological war is under way in which organised crime uses sophisticated aircraft to defeat prison security systems.
quote: che è in atto una guerra tecnologica con la criminalità organizzata determinata a superare i sistemi di sicurezza degli istituti penitenziari attraverso l'impiego di velivoli sofisticatissimi

speaker: Rustamas Liubajevas
claim: Drones are also used for smuggling across the Belarus border, though not on a mass scale like balloons; losing a drone costs smugglers money.
quote: Jei kalbėsime apie dronus, tai jie irgi yra naudojami kontrabandai, tik ne taip masiškai.

speaker: Rustamas Liubajevas
claim: After surveillance systems and a physical barrier were installed, smugglers switched to drones and balloons.
quote: tos priemonės iš tikrųjų apsunkino kontrabandininkams gabenimą per žalią sieną. Jie rado kitų būtų gabenti kontrabandą – dronais, oro balionais.

speaker: Dmitrijs Kaļins
role: head, Latvian Prison Administration (Ieslodzījuma vietu pārvalde)
claim: Drones are not the most popular way to deliver banned items to prisons; parcels, visits and throwing over the fence are more common.
quote: Tomēr vēlos uzsvērt, ka dronu izmantošana nav populārākais aizliegto priekšmetu piegādes veids. Biežāk tiek izmantoti sūtījumi, radinieku vai citu personu apmeklējumi, kā arī mēģinājumi pārmest aizliegtos priekšmetus pāri žogam

speaker: Māris Vitkovskis
role: head, Technical Support Division, State Police
claim: A high-flying small drone is almost impossible to identify without technical means in an urban setting.
quote: Ja viņš augstu lido, tad viņu bez kaut kādiem tehniskiem līdzekļiem identificēt ir gandrīz neiespējami.

speaker: Wim Saris
claim: Intercepting contraband is a cat-and-mouse game; prisons cannot be guaranteed contraband-free despite the anti-drone network.
quote: Het onderscheppen van contrabande is een kat-en-muisspel. Ik kan daarom helaas niet garanderen dat gevangenissen helemaal contrabande vrij worden.

speaker: Annelies Verlinden
claim: Drugs and phones are increasingly flown by drone to prisoners' cell windows, so traditional bars are no longer sufficient.
quote: De traditionele tralies volstaan niet langer, omdat drugs en gsm’s steeds vaker via drones tot bij het celraam van een gedetineerde worden gevlogen

notes: Journalist's paraphrase of the minister's account.
speaker: Annelies Verlinden
claim: A detainee only needs to reach an arm out of the window to take the package hanging under the drone.
quote: Een gedetineerde hoeft maar zijn arm naar buiten te steken om het pakje, dat onder de drone hangt, aan te nemen.

notes: University summary of a Volkskrant interview.
speaker: Esther van Ginneken
claim: Drones used to smuggle items to detainees are a growing problem in prisons.
quote: Drones die worden ingezet om spullen naar gedetineerde te smokkelen zijn een groeiend probleem in gevangenissen.

notes: Anecdotal staff account, not tied to a dated event.
speaker: Complexbeveiligers (prison officers), PI Ter Apel
claim: Night patrols at PI Ter Apel find drug and phone packages hidden in grass on the prison grounds after drone noise at night.
quote: Dan vinden we bijvoorbeeld een pakketje met drugs of mobiele telefoon. Verstopt in een graspol, zodat het niet opvalt.

notes: Found during a walk around the outer walls.
speaker: Complexbeveiligers (prison officers), PI Ter Apel
claim: Staff sometimes find contraband around the outer walls when the string attached to a drone breaks too early.
quote: Dan is het touwtje aan de drone iets te vroeg geknapt.

notes: Reported by NOS; Europol report itself not opened.
speaker: Europol
role: EU law enforcement agency (report on cocaine trafficking)
claim: Europol says drug criminals increasingly use drones, helium balloons and semi-submersibles to smuggle cocaine into Europe.
quote: Drugscriminelen maken steeds vaker gebruik van geavanceerde middelen zoals drones, heliumballonnen en speciaal voor de drugssmokkel gebouwde "semi-onderzeeërs", meldt Europol.

notes: Forecast. Reported by NOS; Europol report itself not opened.
speaker: Europol
role: EU law enforcement agency (report on cocaine trafficking)
claim: Europol expects drug transport to move towards unmanned submarines and expects increased use of drones and helium balloons.
quote: Europol verwacht dat het drugstransport zich in de toekomst steeds meer zal ontwikkelen in de richting van onbemande onderzeeërs en dat ook het gebruik van drones en heliumballonnen zal toenemen.

notes: Same prosecutor also stated drones are a growing problem for prison safety.
speaker: Officier van justitie (Openbaar Ministerie)
claim: The Dutch prosecution service says drones are a growing prison-safety problem and wants dropping phones into prisons by drone classed as a crime rather than a minor offence.
quote: Het OM wil dan ook dat het droppen van telefoons met drones in gevangenissen wordt gezien als misdrijf. Nu is dit een overtreding.

notes: Attribution to the agency is implicit (article voice after SBS data); balloons dominate the article's figures.
speaker: Lithuanian State Border Guard Service (as reported by ELTA/LRT)
claim: Stronger Lithuania-Belarus border protection made land smuggling much harder, so smugglers increasingly use the air route, balloons or drones.
quote: W ostatnich latach, w związku z wzmocnieniem ochrony granicy litewsko-białoruskiej, przemyt drogą lądową stał się znacznie trudniejszy. W rezultacie przemytnicy coraz częściej wykorzystują drogę powietrzną – balony lub drony.

speaker: HM Inspectorate of Prisons (HMIP)
role: prison inspectorate, report on HMP Garth
claim: Inmates at HMP Garth burned holes in plexiglass cell windows and used stolen broom handles to reach drone-delivered drug packages.
quote: Jeden ze sposobów polegał na wypalaniu dziur w oknach z pleksi w celach, aby umożliwić przechwycenie towaru. Inni skazani kradli miotły i szczotki, używając ich trzonków do sięgania po paczki z narkotykami dostarczane przez drony.

speaker: Charlie Taylor
claim: Finding an effective way to stop drones is key to limiting drug deliveries to cells.
quote: Charlie Taylor, główny inspektor, podkreślił, że kluczowe jest znalezienie skutecznego sposobu na zatrzymanie dronów, aby ograniczyć dostarczanie narkotyków do cel.

speaker: The Guardian (cited)
claim: Drone smuggling cases in England and Wales prisons rose tenfold compared with 2020.
quote: Z kolei The Guardian podaje, że liczba przypadków przemytu z użyciem dronów  wzrosła dziesięciokrotnie  w porównaniu z 2020 roku.

speaker: HM Chief Inspector of Prisons for England and Wales
claim: Drones are now a permanent feature of prison life and cannot be eliminated without signal-jamming technology.
quote: z raportu HM Chief Inspector of Prisons for England and Wales wynika, że  drony stały się „stałym elementem” życia więziennego , a ich pełne wyeliminowanie jest obecnie niemożliwe bez technologii zakłócających sygnał.

speaker: GI-TOC (cited)
claim: In Europe, especially the UK, drone incidents are growing exponentially, among the toughest challenges for prisons.
quote: W Europie – szczególnie w Wielkiej Brytanii – liczba incydentów z dronami zwiększa się w tempie wykładniczym, co według The Guardian stanowi  jedno z najpoważniejszych wyzwań dla systemu więziennictwa.

speaker: El País (cited), Spanish police
claim: Spanish police seized a large drone with about 7 hours' endurance and up to 150 kg payload used to move drugs between Morocco and southern Spain.
quote: hiszpańska policja przejęła dużego drona o autonomii około 7 godzin i udźwigu do 150 kg, wykorzystywanego do transportu narkotyków pomiędzy Marokiem a południową Hiszpanią.

speaker: Autoritatea Vamală Română
claim: Customs said two of 24 undocumented drones seized at Calafat were transport drones of the kind used in cigarette smuggling, each able to carry up to 80 kg.
quote: două dintre echipamente erau drone de transport, de felul celor utilizate la contrabanda cu țigări, fiecare putând căra până la 80 de kilograme.

speaker: Inspector General of the Border Police
claim: Smugglers have started using drones to bring cigarettes into Romania, so the Border Police needs aerial surveillance.
quote: Inspectorul general al Poliției de Frontieră susține că e nevoie de pază aeriană deaorece contrabandiștii au început și ei să folosească drone pentru introducerea țigărilor la noi în țară.

speaker: Dragica Rajković
role: Head of treatment department, long-term prison (UIKS)
claim: Prison staff have had cases where a consignment was brought by drone, i.e. a drone attempted to deliver phones.
quote: Imali smo i situacije kada dronovima donesu pošiljku, tj. dron pokuša da odradi unos telefona

speaker: Uprava za izvršenje krivičnih sankcija (UIKS)
claim: Drone sightings over the UIKS prison complex in the last two months exceed the number over the previous two years.
quote: Naglasili su da su u posljednja dva mjeseca policiji prijavili da je u 20 slučajave primijećen dron iznad prostora kompleksa UIKS-a, što je više nego u periodu unazad dvije godine.

notes: No drone event described; counter-measure context.
speaker: Government sources (via Cyprus News Agency)
claim: Cyprus tightened its law in February and installed an anti-drone system in prisons, while increasing checks against phones and drugs.
quote: Cezaevlerinde cep telefonu ve uyuşturucu kullanımına karşı denetimlerin artırıldığı, şubat ayında yasanın sertleştirildiği ve drone karşıtı sistem kurulduğu da bildirildi.

notes: publication_status: refused (security). Aanhangsel Handelingen TK 2024-2025 nr 1246, answer 4, received 2025-02-07, to question by Ellian (VVD) on drones over PI Vught. Same answer: DJI made one piket report of a drone incident in 2024 (PI Vught, 2024-12-23).
speaker: Ingrid Coenradie
role: State Secretary for Justice and Security (Staatssecretaris JenV)
claim: The State Secretary will not publish national figures on drone incidents at prisons for security reasons, because the information could be valuable to criminals.
quote: Uit veiligheidsoverwegingen maak ik deze landelijke cijfers niet openbaar. Deze informatie kan namelijk waardevol zijn voor criminelen.

notes: publication_status: refused (security) for deliveries; drone incidents published in HMPPS Annual Digest table 6_1. PQ 94286 (Carla Lockhart), tabled 2025-11-25, answered 2025-12-03. speaker: Jake Richards
role: Answering minister, Ministry of Justice (UK Parliament written question 94286)
claim: MoJ will not disclose data on drone deliveries of illicit items to prisons for security reasons; published drone incidents are sightings, not proof of delivery.
quote: Data specific to deliveries of illicit items cannot be disclosed for security reasons.

notes: publication_status: refused (security) for recoveries. PQ 106914 (James McMurdock), grouped with 106912-106913, answered 2026-01-26.
speaker: Jake Richards
role: Answering minister, Ministry of Justice (UK Parliament written question 106914)
claim: MoJ will not disclose data on recoveries of illicit items delivered by drone, for security reasons.
quote: Data specific to the recoveries of illicit items cannot be disclosed for security reasons.

speaker: Jake Richards
role: Answering minister, Ministry of Justice (UK Parliament written question 99225)
claim: Prison drone statistics before April 2020 cannot be provided because they were not equivalently recorded or assured; official statistics began July 2025.
quote: Drone statistics back to 2015 cannot be provided, having not been equivalently recorded or assured.

notes: publication_status: no plans to publish regularly. PQs 670-671 [69793/25, 69794/25] by Ken O'Flynn TD, Dáil 2025-12-09. The minister's name is not printed on the fetched record (office only).
speaker: Minister for Justice, Home Affairs and Migration
role: Minister (Dáil written answer to PQs 670 and 671)
claim: There are no current plans to publish prison drone incursion information on an ongoing basis because of security risk to the prison estate.
quote: There are no current plans to publish this information on an ongoing basis due to the risk of compromising the integrity, security, or safety of the prison estate.

notes: publication_status: no 2023 data. PQ 21481/25 (Gary Gannon TD), 2025-04-30. speaker: Jim O'Callaghan
role: Minister for Justice (Dáil written answer to PQs 129-130 [21481/25])
claim: The Irish Prison Service has no drone detection figures for 2023; figures supplied start in 2024 (Operational Support Group).
quote: The Deputy should note there are no figures available for 2023.

notes: publication_status: classified (VS). Reported speech by CORRECTIV (Ulrich Kraetzer, 2025-10-15), not a primary BKA document. Same article: 'Bis zum 1. Oktober registrierte das BKA ... „eine niedrige, vierstellige Anzahl von Drohnenüberflügen“'. Context class: security_sighting (state/hybrid), not criminal use.
speaker: Bundeskriminalamt (spokesperson)
role: Federal Criminal Police Office, via CORRECTIV inquiry
claim: BKA classifies the exact number of drone overflights of defence firms, military sites and critical infrastructure; it gave only 'a low four-digit number' for 2025 to 1 October.
quote: Die genaue Zahl sei allerdings als Verschlusssache eingestuft, sagte ein Sprecher des BKA.

speaker: Niedersächsisches Ministerium für Inneres, Sport und Digitalisierung
role: Land interior ministry, answer to Kleine Anfrage Drs 19/8789 (Drs 19/9172)
claim: Lower Saxony refused to break down drone sightings by type of critical-infrastructure site because publication could endanger the facilities.
quote: Eine solche Veröffentlichung ist daher geeignet, die Sicherheit der Einrichtungen bzw. Teile der Einrichtungen zu gefährden und mithin dem Wohl des Landes Niedersachsen Nachteile zuzufügen.

speaker: Niedersächsisches Ministerium für Inneres, Sport und Digitalisierung
role: Land interior ministry, answer to Kleine Anfrage Drs 19/10058 (Drs 19/10345)
claim: Lower Saxony says only the Bundestag can obtain BKA situation-picture figures; within the BKA collection Lower Saxony had incidents in the low three digits in 2025.
quote: Das parlamentarische Auskunftsrecht über Lagebilder der Bundesbehörden obliegt demnach ausschließlich dem Bundestag.

notes: publication_status: refused (to press). Reported by CORRECTIV 2025-10-15; no primary police document. Context class: security_sighting.
speaker: Landespolizeiamt Schleswig-Holstein
role: Land police office, via CORRECTIV inquiry
claim: Schleswig-Holstein police say they register reports of suspicious drone flights but refused to give numbers.
quote: Das Landespolizeiamt Schleswig-Holstein versicherte auf Anfrage zwar, Meldungen über verdächtige Drohnenflüge zu registrieren, weigerte sich aber, Zahlen zu nennen.

notes: publication_status: not collected. Reported by CORRECTIV 2025-10-15; no primary document. Bayern LKA is in the article but not on the inventory sheet. Refers to (suspicious) drone flights generally, not prison or criminal-use counts.
speaker: Polizei Hamburg; Polizei Sachsen-Anhalt; Landeskriminalamt Bayern
role: Land police authorities, via CORRECTIV inquiry
claim: Police in Hamburg and Saxony-Anhalt and the Bavarian LKA said they do not record data on drone flights.
quote: Die Polizeibehörden in Hamburg, Sachsen-Anhalt und das Landeskriminalamt Bayern teilten mit, dass man Daten zu Drohnenflügen nicht erfasse.

notes: publication_status: not collected (sightings). Reported by CORRECTIV 2025-10-15. Same article: Baden-Württemberg 'führt keine gesonderte Statistik über Drohnensichtungen'.
speaker: Polizei Berlin
claim: Berlin police keep no statistic of drone sightings and pointed instead to investigations opened for allegedly unlawful drone flights.
quote: Die Polizei Berlin teilte mit, keine eigene Statistik zu Drohnensichtungen zu führen und verwies ersatzweise ebenfalls auf die Zahl der Ermittlungsverfahren, die wegen mutmaßlich rechtswidriger Drohnenflügen eingeleiteten wurden.

notes: publication_status: not collected. speaker: Czesław Mroczek
role: Secretary of State, Ministry of Interior and Administration (MSWiA), reply to Sejm interpellation 10829
claim: Polish police do not collect data on notified drone flights, including German services' use of thermal-imaging drones in border areas.
quote: Policja nie gromadzi danych dotyczących zgłaszanych lotów, w tym dotyczących użycia dronów z termowizją przez niemieckie służby w rejonach przygranicznych.

notes: publication_status: not disclosed (to press). ERR characterisation, published 2025-06-20 about events in October 2024; the inventory dates the statement Oct 2024. speaker: Arbo Probal; Estonian Defence Forces
role: Head of uncrewed aerial systems, Estonian Defence Forces (Lt Col res.)
claim: The Defence Forces left unclear how many drones and operators were involved in flights near Tapa and Jõhvi bases in October 2024 and declined to detail their response.
quote: Kaitseväe esindaja jättis ebamääraseks selle, kui palju droone ja nende lennutajaid oli.

notes: publication_status: collected, no published series located. Contradicts a reading of the inventory 'France: no ministry overflight series' as non-collection: DAP collects incident reports since 2022-10-31; figures surface only in parliamentary answers and press.
speaker: Ministère de la Justice
role: Garde des sceaux, answer to Senate written question 05873 (Pascal Allizard)
claim: Since a DAP note of 31 October 2022, every drone overflight of a prison is reported as an incident by the establishment; the ministry gave 61 overflights neutralised in 2022.
quote: Chaque survol de drone fait par ailleurs l'objet d'un signalement d'incident par la direction de l'établissement concerné, en application de la note prise par le directeur de l'administration pénitentiaire le 31 octobre 2022 en matière de remontées d'informations relatives aux survols de drones.

notes: publication_status: figures released to press, not as a published series. Same article: drone deliveries 37 (2021) to 2121 (2025), source not named beyond context of the administration pénitentiaire (see X04_aggregates).
speaker: Ministère de la Justice (Chancellerie)
role: Ministry of Justice, quoted by Europe 1
claim: The ministry says the rise in recorded drone overflight attempts at prisons reflects much better detection, not an explosion of the phenomenon.
quote: ne traduit pas une explosion du phénomène, mais l’amélioration très nette de sa détection

notes: publication_status: no unified statistic (non-official speaker). No Greek authority statement on publication found; the General Secretariat for Anti-Crime Policy gives only a running count (5th thwarted incident of 2026).
speaker: Nikolaos Tsoumas
role: Director of Flight Operations, Vanguard Drones (industry, not an authority)
claim: There is not yet, at least publicly, a unified statistical picture in Greece of how many drone incidents at prisons happen each year.

speaker: Spanish police
claim: Drones used by the smuggling group were produced by small manufacturers in Ukraine and brought to Spain by road.
quote: Ifølge politiet ble dronene produsert av småprodusenter i Ukraina og fraktet til Spania via landeveien.

speaker: Spanish police
claim: Customers of the dismantled drone-building gang included criminal groups in Denmark, France, Italy and Spain.
quote: Den optrevlede bandes kunder omfattede kriminelle bander i Danmark, Frankrig, Italien og Spanien, oplyser det spanske politi.

speaker: Metropolitan Police
claim: Investigators assess that the drone gang was behind most of the drone flights dropping illegal packages into London prisons.
quote: Ifølge Metropolitan Police vurderer efterforskerne, at dronebanden stod bag størstedelen af de droneflyvninger, hvor ulovlige pakker er blevet dumpet ned i fængslerne i London.

notes: Union representative, not an agency statement.
speaker: Rudy Manna
role: departmental secretary Bouches-du-Rhône, Alliance Police nationale (union)
claim: Police union says dealers use drones where police are not permitted to use them.
quote: Eux, ils utilisent des drones là où nous on ne peut pas les utiliser.

notes: Union communiqué.
speaker: FO Justice
claim: Union says prison staff must keep working with means that are manifestly not up to the scale of the drone and projection phenomenon.
quote: Et les personnels continuent de devoir composer avec des moyens qui ne sont manifestement pas à la hauteur du phénomène.

speaker: Frédéric Stoll
claim: Drones deliver to inmates who ordered goods several times a night and even in daytime at Dijon prison.

speaker: Ghislain Karleskind
claim: Legal limits stop guards using anti-drone equipment at full capacity; they can geolocate the pilot but must only alert police, then search delivered cells the next day.

claim: Drone pilots at Spanish prisons now fly precise night flights with lights taped over and place loads at specific cell windows; inmates retrieve them with improvised poles.
quote: Los pilotos realizan vuelos nocturnos de gran precisión, cubren las luces del aparato con cinta negra para hacerlo prácticamente invisible y consiguen situar la carga justo frente a las ventanas de determinadas celdas.

speaker: Valencia Noticias
claim: Alhaurín de la Torre prison (Málaga) has accumulated dozens of drone sightings used to bring in contraband; the problem affects many Spanish prisons.
quote: El problema afecta a numerosas cárceles españolas y algunas, como la de Alhaurín de la Torre (Málaga), acumulan decenas de avistamientos de drones utilizados para introducir contrabando.

notes: Union representative on TV, not an agency.
speaker: Lidia, ACAIP delegate
role: prison officer and union delegate, ACAIP
claim: Drones are being used to bring phones and drugs into Spanish prisons; she warns they could carry weapons and says prisons lack drone jammers.
quote: En una prisión, que alberga gente que comete actos vandálicos como estos, deberíamos tener inhibidores de drones, pero a día de hoy no disponemos de estos mecanismos.

notes: Interview; speaker is a staff member, not an agency statement.
speaker: Prison officer (interviewee, first name only)
claim: Drones with built-in cameras deliver goods to cell windows: the outside pilot sees the exact window, the drone lowers a line carrying up to half a kilo and leaves.
quote: Los drones llevan cámaras integradas; el piloto exterior ve la ventana exacta, el preso saca la mano, el dron suelta la cuerda con hasta medio kilo de mercancía y vuelve a salir.

notes: Union assertion, no figures given.
speaker: ACAIP (prison union), Tahíche section
claim: Union says seizures of mobile phones at the prison have increased exponentially in recent months.
quote: ACAIP asegura que la incautación de estos terminales ha aumentado de forma exponencial en los últimos meses.

speaker: ACAIP (prison union), Tahíche section
claim: Prison-drone operations usually happen at night to avoid detection, and the devices are increasingly quiet and harder to detect by sound.
quote: Aunque este tipo de operaciones suele realizarse durante la noche para dificultar su detección, la organización recuerda que estos dispositivos son cada vez más silenciosos y, por tanto, más difíciles de localizar incluso por el sonido.

speaker: Reuters (reported by El Imparcial)
claim: At Cosenza prison, acrylic screens fitted over windows since 2021 to stop drones delivering phones and other prohibited items were removed in 2026 heat because they blocked airflow.
quote: Esas barreras tenían como finalidad impedir que drones introdujeran teléfonos celulares y otros objetos prohibidos en la cárcel.

notes: Drone clause is the journalist's gloss on the EUDA report, not a direct EUDA quote.
speaker: EUDA (summarised by Xataka)
claim: Xataka reports the EUDA's conclusion that cocaine flows have not fallen but traffickers shift to smaller ports, drones and better concealment.
quote: Buscan puertos más pequeños, recurren a drones, disimulan mejor sus alijos…

speaker: Udyco Algeciras, Policía Nacional (via ABC)
claim: Police report growing use of unmanned vehicles, aerial drones and semi-submersibles, to bring drugs into Spain, reducing criminal logistics and being hard to detect.
quote: creciente actividad en el uso de todo tipo de vehículos no tripulados como método de introducción de sustancias estupefacientes en España

notes: Opinion piece relaying AFP; no date of AFP report.
speaker: AFP (reported by OKDiario)
claim: AFP reported drone deliveries of drugs to Strasbourg-Elsau prison are so frequent that the prefecture banned night landings of medical helicopters at Hautepierre hospital.
quote: los drones que realizan entregas de droga y otros productos a los reclusos de la prisión de Estrasburgo-Elsau son tan frecuentes que, para evitar accidentes, la prefectura ha prohibido a los helicópteros sanitarios

notes: Opinion piece; describes police operation, no date or arrests given.
speaker: Ricardo Magaz
role: professor of criminal phenomenology, UNED; op-ed author
claim: Op-ed says Policía Nacional's Operation Horus revealed large automated drones carrying about 20 kg of hashish per trip from Morocco to Ceuta, Melilla or inland Andalusia.
quote: aparatos automatizados de gran tamaño capaces de transportar en cada viaje alrededor de veinte kilos de hachís desde Marruecos hasta Ceuta, Melilla o el interior de Andalucía

speaker: Fiscalía de Andalucía, Ceuta y Melilla
claim: Prosecutors report seizures of technological equipment from drug trafficking groups in Andalusia, including night-vision gear, surveillance cameras, drones, jammers and encrypted communications.
quote: visores nocturnos, cámaras de vigilancia, drones, inhibidores, y comunicaciones seguras encriptadas

speaker: Fiscalía de Andalucía
claim: Prosecutors say the equipment of Andalusian drug organisations, including war weapons, drones, surveillance cameras and signal jammers, worries them most.
quote: Lo que más inquieta a los fiscales es el equipamiento de las organizaciones: armas de guerra, drones, cámaras de vigilancia e inhibidores de señal.

speaker: Fiscalía de Andalucía, Ceuta y Melilla
claim: Prosecutors' annual report lists drones among surveillance and secure-communications equipment seized from cannabis trafficking groups in Granada.
quote: "visores nocturnos, cámaras de vigilancia , drones, inhibidores, y comunicaciones seguras encriptadas"

notes: Mayor, not a law-enforcement agency.
speaker: Francisco de la Torre
claim: Mayor says drug-trafficking gangs are adding drones and more sophisticated weapons to their organisations.
quote: De la Torre dijo que las bandas de narcotraficantes están incorporando a sus organizaciones «drones y armas aún más sofisticadas».

notes: Reported by STT/MTV from AFP interview
speaker: Charlotte von Essen
claim: Some drone sightings in Sweden have turned out to be linked to ordinary crime, and some could not be verified.
quote: Jotkut droonihavainnot ovat osoittautuneet tavalliseen rikollisuuteen liittyviksi ja joitakin ei ole voitu todentaa, hän sanoi.

speaker: senior police sources (unnamed), via Journal du Dimanche
claim: Drones were already used for prison drops, deal-point lookouts and deliveries, but a mini-drone used for a burglary like this is entirely new.
quote: le recours à un mini-drone pour un tel fric-frac, c’est totalement inédit

speaker: Cédric Boyer
claim: Drones are a security scourge around prisons.
quote: Les drones sont un fléau sécuritaire autour des établissements pénitentiaires.

speaker: Pierre Grousset
claim: At Perpignan prison drone deliveries happen almost every night.
quote: À Perpignan, c’est pratiquement toutes les nuits qu’on a des livraisons par drone

speaker: Pierre Grousset
claim: Deliveries arrive between 3 and 4 am and often go unnoticed.
quote: Comme ils viennent livrer entre 3 et 4 heures du matin, il y a des livraisons qui passent inaperçues

speaker: CNEWS
claim: Drugs, Amazon keys and earphones are the items most often sent by drone; weapons and explosives are feared.
quote: Parmi les objets les plus souvent envoyés par les moyens d’un drone : des produits stupéfiants, des clés Amazon, des écouteurs…

speaker: CNEWS
claim: Since the start of 2023 overflights and deliveries have multiplied very sharply.
quote: depuis le début de l’année, ces survols et livraisons se sont très fortement multipliés

speaker: Direction interrégionale des services pénitentiaires
claim: Illegal delivery of material by drone has become a scourge.
quote: a pointé du doigt la livraison illégale de matériel par drone devenue un fléau

speaker: Gregory Wallez
claim: Drones can deliver drugs, food and phones directly to the cell window.
quote: Les drones peuvent livrer directement par la fenêtre de la cellule. Drogue, dürüm, hamburgers, GSM…

speaker: Kathleen Van De Vijver
claim: The prison administration is exploring detection solutions and awaits a legal framework for neutralisation.
quote: prospecte activement les solutions disponibles sur le marché en termes de détection et (qu'on) demeure en attente d'un potentiel cadre légal pour la neutralisation

speaker: Le Monde (journalists Mestre and Saintourens)
claim: Delivered items include phones, SIM cards, cocaine and knives, mostly cannabis resin; guards call the practice 'Uber shit'.
quote: Les objets livrés sont divers : téléphones, cartes SIM, cocaïne, armes blanches mais surtout de la résine de cannabis.

speaker: Le Monde (journalists Mestre and Saintourens)
claim: Drone deliveries occurred in recent months at prisons in Gradignan, Nîmes, Beauvais, Strasbourg, Roanne, Ploemeur, Perpignan and Lyon.
quote: Ces derniers mois, des livraisons par drone ont eu comme décor les prisons de Gradignan (Gironde), de Nîmes, de Beauvais, de Strasbourg, de Roanne (Loire), de Ploemeur (Morbihan)… Mais aussi de Perpignan ou de Lyon.

speaker: Anonymous detainee, Bouches-du-Rhône prison (via BFMTV)
claim: A detainee reports at least 5 to 6 drone deliveries per day at his prison.
quote: « 5 à 6 livraisons par jour minimum ». Voilà ce que révèle un détenu d’une prison du département des Bouches-du-Rhône.

speaker: Cyril Huet-Lambing
role: general delegate, syndicat pénitentiaire des surveillants (SPS)
claim: Guards lack staff, coercive means and equipment to stop drone deliveries; nearly a kilogram was delivered to cells in late October.
quote: pas d’effectif, pas de moyens coercitifs, pas de moyens matériels… C’est impossible

speaker: Renaud Gaudeul
claim: No drone-delivery case of this scale is known in France; a parallel reception organisation inside Nantes prison is probable.
quote: Ce sont des faits tout sauf anodins. A ma connaissance, il n’y a jamais eu une affaire [de livraison par drones] d’une telle envergure en France

notes: Attribution to Europol is by article context (AFP report on the Europol-EMCDDA module)
speaker: Europol
role: EU law enforcement agency (EU Drug Market analysis on cannabis, with EMCDDA)
claim: Cannabis trafficking methods have diversified, with traffickers now using drones, helicopters or unmanned semi-submersible vessels.
quote: Les méthodes pour acheminer le cannabis se sont aussi diversifiées avec des trafiquants utilisant désormais drones, hélicoptères ou navires semi-submersibles sans pilote.

notes: Second-hand union report, no specific prison named; Carcassonne seizure itself not drone-related.
speaker: Pierre Journet
role: UFAP Unsa union representative, Carcassonne prison
claim: Colleagues report that in some remand prisons inmates have smartphones delivered by drone and film the parcels from their cells.
quote: Dans certaines Maisons d’arrêt, nos collègues nous ont signalé que des détenus se faisaient livrer par drone des smartphones et filmaient avec d’autres téléphones

speaker: OFDT (ESSPRI survey authors)
role: Observatoire français des drogues et des tendances addictives
claim: Authors of the national prison substance-use survey list drone deliveries among routes by which prohibited goods enter prisons, alongside over-wall throws, visits, mail and staff.
quote: Ils évoquent les projections par des tiers au-dessus des murs de la prison à l’intérieur des cours de promenade, les livraisons par drones, la transmission grâce à un visiteur au parloir ou par le courrier

speaker: Unnamed judicial source (to 20 Minutes)
claim: Phones enter French prisons via visits, staff complicity, throwers and drones.
quote: Il y a plusieurs moyens de faire rentrer des téléphones en détention : les parloirs, la complicité de gens qui travaillent en prison, les lanceurs, les drones…

notes: Magazine statement, no named official; Morocco-to-Spain route
speaker: TelQuel (Moroccan weekly, relayed by Courrier international)
claim: Drug mafias increasingly use drones to deliver cannabis to the Spanish coast from Morocco.
quote: Mais la mafia de la drogue a de plus en plus recours à des moyens sophistiqués, notamment les drones, pour  “livrer du cannabis sur les côtes espagnoles”

speaker: Ufap Unsa Justice union delegate, Béziers prison
claim: Drone deliveries to Béziers prison occur almost every day and night, operated by accomplices outside.
quote: les livraisons par  drones,  « quasiment tous les jours et toutes les nuits » et ces objets retrouvés dans les cellules proviennent de ces engins volants actionnés par des complices
